title: Little Nachman, Concluding Part 27
body:
with translation by Rabbi Lazer Brody
and illustrations by Rebecca Shapiro

Little Nachman – Concluding Part 27

If you go to bed at night, and you’re a little bit worried or afraid of something, remember that you’re not alone. Hashem is always with you.

You can say: "Hashem, help me feel that You’re right here with me so that I won’t be afraid of the dark or of being alone. Let me feel that I’m safe and that You’re always watching over me. How wonderful it is to know that when I go to bed, You tuck me in; while I’m sleeping, You never leave the room. When I wake up, You’re right there too. Thank You, Hashem, for being such a loving Father in Heaven. Thank You, Hashem, for being there whenever I need You. Thank You, Hashem, that I have You. Thank You, thank You!"

Click on the above image and it becomes a full page poster for you to print and hang in your bedroom!
